metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: KaunBatayega par verified service categories dekhein.

hero.title: Roz ke zaroori kaam ke liye sahi help dhoondhein.
hero.copy: Service category chunein aur samjhein ki kaunsa verified provider aapki help kar sakta hai.

overview.title: Aapko kaunsi service chahiye?
overview.copy: Main KaunBatayega service categories browse karein. Services menu se kisi bhi section par direct ja sakte hain.

legal-services.overview: Notices, agreements, affidavits aur local legal paperwork ke liye legal professionals ki help.
problems: Sahi documents prepare karne mein difficulty
Local legal work start karne ka reliable point nahi

gst-taxation.overview: Shopkeepers, small businesses aur individuals ke liye GST, taxation aur filing support.

business-registration.overview: Shop, firm, company ya local business start/register karne mein support.

property-documentation.overview: Property papers, registry support, mutation aur rent agreement documentation mein help.

police-verification.overview: Police verification, tenant verification aur related affidavits ke liye guidance.

electricity.overview: Electricity connection, bill, meter aur department-related service work mein support.

insurance.overview: Insurance documents, policy support aur claim paperwork ke liye guidance.

municipal-services.overview: Municipal services, local certificates aur city-level civic paperwork mein help.

government-schemes.overview: Government schemes, eligibility aur application steps samajhne mein help.

licenses-permits.overview: Trade, food, shop aur other licenses ya permits ke liye support.

documentation.overview: Aadhaar, PAN, certificates, affidavits aur common documents ke liye professional help.

labour-compliance.overview: Labour registration, contractor paperwork aur compliance needs ke liye support.

labels.benefitsCopy: Clear category selection, verified provider profiles, better document expectations aur reliable shuruaat.

items.question: Kya services aaj book ho sakti hain?
items.answer: Customer booking prepare ho rahi hai. Abhi focus providers ko onboard aur verify karna hai.

items.question: Itni categories kyun hain?
items.answer: KaunBatayega roz ke un kaamon ko cover karta hai jahan trusted local professionals aur sahi documents chahiye hote hain.

items.question: Kya providers verified honge?
items.answer: Haan. Customer visibility se pehle provider verification core model ka hissa hai.

items.question: Kya main service category suggest kar sakta hoon?
items.answer: Haan. Contact page se category ya city suggest karein.
